i. The auditor shall make his report available only after taking note of the SSB's draft report on the IFI's compliance with Shari'a Rules and Principles.
ii. If, based on the SSB's draft report indicating lack of compliance, the auditor modifies his draft report, he shall provide an adequate explanation of the nature of and reasons for the modification.
en.A: i and iii
en.B: i, ii and iv
en.C: ii, iii and iv
en.D: i, ii, iii and iv
en.True answer: i, ii and iv
en.main: Para 16: the auditor makes his report available only after taking note of the SSB's draft report (i), and if he modifies his draft based on the SSB's draft report indicating lack of compliance, he explains the nature of and reasons for the modification (ii). Para 17: before the SSB's final report, the auditor makes his draft report and Shari'a compliance conclusions available to the SSB (iv). Statement (iii) reverses the required sequence.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 05: Fraud and Error
en.Question:
During the audit of Al-Barakah Islamic Bank, the auditor identifies the following misstatements. Which of them constitute FRAUD as defined in ASIFI 5?
i. Fraud and error risk factors identified during the assessment process, and the auditor's response to them
ii. Risk factors identified during the audit that lead to additional audit procedures, and the auditor's response
iii. Discussions held with SSB members, with conclusions supported by AAOIFI Shari'a standards and the SSB's fatwas, rulings and guidelines
iv. A forensic authentication report for each significant contract examined
en.A: i and iv
en.B: i, ii and iv
en.C: ii and iii
en.D: i, iii and iv
en.True answer: i and iv
en.main: Para 5: fraud is an INTENTIONAL act involving deception to obtain an unjust or illegal advantage, including intentional misallocation of profits between the IFI and IAH/PA (i) and intentional, consistent violation and misinterpretation of AAOIFI Shari'a standards and SSB fatwas (iv). Para 4: error is an UNINTENTIONAL misstatement, including incorrect application and oversight of Shari'a rules (ii) and incorrect accounting estimates from oversight or misunderstanding of facts (iii).

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 05: Fraud and Error
en.Question: After a large fraud is discovered in an Islamic bank's Mudaraba portfolio, the board publicly blames the external auditor for failing to prevent it. Under ASIFI 5, where does the primary responsibility for the prevention and detection of fraud and error rest?*
en.A: With the external auditor, since an audit is designed to detect all fraud
en.B: With the Shari'a Supervisory Board, since the fraud involved investment accountholders' funds
en.C: With those charged with corporate governance and management of the IFI; the audit may act as a deterrent, but the auditor is not and cannot be held responsible for preventing fraud and error
en.D: Jointly and equally with management and the external auditor
en.True answer: With those charged with corporate governance and management of the IFI; the audit may act as a deterrent, but the auditor is not and cannot be held responsible for preventing fraud and error
en.main: Paras 1 and 17: the PRIMARY responsibility for the prevention and detection of fraud and error rests with those charged with corporate governance and management of the IFI and of the funds of IAH and PPara 6: an audit provides reasonable assurance that the financial statements are free from material misstatement; the fact that an audit is carried out may act as a deterrent, but the auditor is not and cannot be held responsible for preventing fraud and error.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 05: Fraud and Error
en.Question: In which of the following situations would the external auditor of an Islamic bank be held responsible for negligence and misconduct under ASIFI 5?*
en.A: A sophisticated collusive fraud remained undetected despite a properly designed and planned audit
en.B: The auditor became aware of a material fraud involving investment accountholders' funds but took no action to report it to the appropriate authority
en.C: Management concealed forged documents that the auditor reasonably accepted as genuine
en.D: A misstatement below materiality caused by error was not detected
en.True answer: The auditor became aware of a material fraud involving investment accountholders' funds but took no action to report it to the appropriate authority
en.main: Para 7: the auditor shall be held responsible for negligence and misconduct if (a) reasonable efforts are not seen to have been made in designing and planning the audit to detect fraud and error, and/or (b) the auditor was AWARE of material fraud and error and did not take the necessary action to report it to the appropriate authority. Options A, C and D reflect the inherent limitations of an audit (paras 6, 9).

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 05: Fraud and Error
en.Question: The SSB of an Islamic bank has issued an unqualified report stating that the bank complied with Shari'a Rules and Principles during the year. The audit senior proposes to rely solely on this report and perform no Shari'a compliance procedures. Under ASIFI 5, how should this proposal be evaluated?*
en.A: It is acceptable, because the SSB is responsible for interpreting Shari'a Rules and Principles
en.B: It is acceptable, provided the SSB report is signed by all SSB members
en.C: It is acceptable only if internal audit has also confirmed compliance
en.D: It is not acceptable, because applying professional skepticism the auditor evaluates management's compliance with AAOIFI Shari'a standards and SSB fatwas, and the SSB's report shall not be the sole basis for the auditor's conclusion
en.True answer: It is not acceptable, because applying professional skepticism the auditor evaluates management's compliance with AAOIFI Shari'a standards and SSB fatwas, and the SSB's report shall not be the sole basis for the auditor's conclusion
en.main: Para 8: the auditor plans and performs the audit with professional skepticism, which is needed to identify and evaluate management's compliance with all AAOIFI Shari'a standards and the SSB's fatwas, rulings and guidelines. In addition, the SSB's report shall NOT be the sole basis for the auditor's conclusion on management's compliance with Shari'a Rules and Principles.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 05: Fraud and Error
en.Question: During the audit of Murabaha transactions, the auditor examines supplier invoices and sale contracts. Nothing in the audit indicates that these documents are not genuine. A board member asks whether the auditor has authenticated every document as an expert woulWhich response is consistent with ASIFI 5?*
en.A: Unless the audit reveals evidence to the contrary, the auditor is entitled to accept records and documents as genuine; an audit rarely contemplates authentication of documents, and auditors are not trained or expected to be authentication experts
en.B: The auditor must authenticate every document examined, since forged documents are a common fraud technique
en.C: The auditor must engage a forensic expert for all Murabaha contracts in every audit
en.D: The auditor must obtain the SSB's certification that all contracts are genuine
en.True answer: Unless the audit reveals evidence to the contrary, the auditor is entitled to accept records and documents as genuine; an audit rarely contemplates authentication of documents, and auditors are not trained or expected to be authentication experts
en.main: Para 9: unless the audit reveals evidence to the contrary, the auditor is entitled to accept records and documents as genuine. An audit in accordance with ASIFI and IFAC standards rarely contemplates authentication of documentation, nor are auditors trained as, or expected to be, experts in such authentication. Professional skepticism (para 8) still applies if contrary evidence arises.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 05: Fraud and Error
en.Question: When planning the audit of an Islamic insurance (Takaful) company, which of the following best describes the scope of the auditor's fraud and error risk assessment under ASIFI 5?*
en.A: Only the shareholders' financial statements, since policyholders' funds are managed under a separate contract
en.B: Only the policyholders' fund, since that is where most fraud risk arises
en.C: The risk that fraud and error may cause material misstatement in the financial statements as well as in the assets, balances and income of the funds of policyholders (PA)
en.D: Only the transactions selected for review by the SSB
en.True answer: The risk that fraud and error may cause material misstatement in the financial statements as well as in the assets, balances and income of the funds of policyholders (PA)
en.main: Para 10: in planning the audit, the auditor shall assess the risk that fraud and error may cause the financial statements AS WELL AS the assets, balances and income of the funds of IAH/PA to contain material misstatement. Para 5 notes that misappropriation and misuse of IAH and PA funds are typical fraud cases in IFIs.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 05: Fraud and Error
en.Question:
In addition to inquiries of management, which of the following inquiries are required under ASIFI 5?
i. Discussions with SSB members relating to professional judgement, interpretation, compliance and application of Shari'a rules and principles
ii. Inquiries of the extent of transactions covered by the Shari'a review
iii. Individual inquiries of every investment accountholder about their profit distributions
iv. Inquiries of whether management, the audit committee or SSB members are aware of any suspected, discovered, investigated or reported fraud and errors
en.A: i and iii
en.B: i, ii and iv
en.C: ii, iii and iv
en.D: i, ii, iii and iv
en.True answer: i, ii and iv
en.main: Para 11 requires inquiries including discussions with SSB members on judgement, interpretation, compliance and application of Shari'a (i), the extent of transactions covered by the Shari'a review (ii), controls over investment of IAH/PA assets, and internal controls safeguarding IAH/PA funds. Para 12 requires asking management, the audit committee or SSB members about known or suspected fraud and errors (iv). Inquiring of every accountholder individually (iii) is not required.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 05: Fraud and Error
en.Question: The auditor concludes that an Islamic bank's financial statements are materially misstated because management intentionally manipulated records to conceal losses in the IAH pool, and management refuses to correct them. Under ASIFI 5, what should the auditor do?*
en.A: Issue an unqualified opinion, since the primary responsibility for fraud rests with management
en.B: Withdraw immediately without issuing any report or communicating with anyone
en.C: Refer the matter to the SSB and adopt the SSB's conclusion as the audit opinion
en.D: Consider the implications for the audit and decide whether to continue the audit with the issuance of a qualified opinion or possibly a disclaimer of opinion
en.True answer: Consider the implications for the audit and decide whether to continue the audit with the issuance of a qualified opinion or possibly a disclaimer of opinion
en.main: Para 13: when the auditor concludes that the financial statements are materially misstated as a result of fraud and error, the auditor shall consider the implications for the audit and decide whether the audit shall be continued with the issuance of a QUALIFIED opinion or POSSIBLE DISCLAIMER. Para 7 also makes the auditor responsible for reporting known material fraud to the appropriate authority.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 05: Fraud and Error
en.Question:
Which of the following documentation requirements are set out in ASIFI 5?
i. Fraud and error risk factors identified during the assessment process, and the auditor's response to them
ii. Risk factors identified during the audit that lead to additional audit procedures, and the auditor's response
iii. Discussions held with SSB members, with conclusions supported by AAOIFI Shari'a standards and the SSB's fatwas, rulings and guidelines
iv. A forensic authentication report for each significant contract examined
en.A: i and ii only
en.B: ii, iii and iv
en.C: i, ii and iii
en.D: i, ii, iii and iv
en.True answer: i, ii and iii
en.main: Para 14 requires documenting fraud and error risk factors identified and the auditor's response, including those identified during the audit that require additional procedures (i, ii). Para 15 requires documenting the reasoning on significant judgemental matters and management's responses to fraud risk factors. Para 16 requires documenting discussions with SSB members, supported by AAOIFI Shari'a standards and SSB fatwas (iii). Authentication reports (iv) are not required (para 9).

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 05: Fraud and Error
en.Question: Which of the following is NOT among the written representations that ASIFI 5 requires the auditor to obtain from management?*
en.A: That the SSB members are competent and independent
en.B: That management has complied with all requirements of AAOIFI Shari'a standards and the SSB's fatwas, rulings and guidelines
en.C: That management has presented all of the SSB's fatwas, rulings and guidelines to the auditors
en.D: That management has placed the necessary controls over the assets, income and balances of the IAH/PA
en.True answer: That the SSB members are competent and independent
en.main: Para 20 requires written representations that management (a) has complied with AAOIFI Shari'a standards and SSB fatwas; (b) has disclosed all known matters of concern relating to fraud and error; (c) has complied with IAH/PA contracts; (d) has presented all SSB fatwas, rulings and guidelines to the auditors; and (e) has placed necessary controls over IAH/PA assets, income and balances. A representation on SSB members' competence is not listed.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: An external Shari'ah audit team asks how ASIFI 6 relates to ISAE 3000 'Assurance Engagements Other than Audits or Reviews of Historical Financial Information'. Which statement is correct?
en.A: ASIFI 6 replaces ISAE 3000 entirely for external Shari'ah audits
en.B: ASIFI 6 is read in conjunction with ISAE 3000, whose requirements apply unless contrary to or inconsistent with a specific requirement of ASIFI 6 or a requirement of Shari'ah
en.C: ISAE 3000 prevails over ASIFI 6 in all cases, since it is the international standard
en.D: ISAE 3000 applies only to attestation engagements, while ASIFI 6 applies only to direct engagements
en.True answer: ASIFI 6 is read in conjunction with ISAE 3000, whose requirements apply unless contrary to or inconsistent with a specific requirement of ASIFI 6 or a requirement of Shari'ah
en.main: Paras 2-3: ASIFI 6 shall be read in conjunction with ISAE 3000, and ISAE 3000's requirements apply UNLESS contrary to or inconsistent with a requirement of ASIFI 6 (being specific in nature) or a requirement of Shari'ah. BC10-BC11: AAOIFI developed ASIFI 6 as a complementary standard rather than a comprehensive one.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: The regulator in Country Y requires management of each Islamic bank to publish an annual statement of compliance with Shari'ah principles and rules and wants the external Shari'ah auditor to report on that statement. In Country Z, there is no such requirement. Which form of external Shari'ah audit is appropriate in each country under ASIFI 6?
en.A: Country Y: attestation external Shari'ah audit; Country Z: direct external Shari'ah audit, which is the form preferred by the standard
en.B: Both countries: attestation external Shari'ah audit, which is the form preferred by the standard
en.C: Both countries: direct external Shari'ah audit, since attestation engagements are not permitted
en.D: Country Y: direct external Shari'ah audit; Country Z: attestation external Shari'ah audit
en.True answer: Country Y: attestation external Shari'ah audit; Country Z: direct external Shari'ah audit, which is the form preferred by the standard
en.main: Para 5: an engagement takes the form of (a) a DIRECT external Shari'ah audit, PREFERRED by the standard, or (b) an ATTESTATION audit where required by regulators and where a statement of compliance is required from management. BC14: direct audits provide a higher level of assurance due to the extent of procedures and the form of reporting.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: Which of the following correctly distinguishes the objectives of the two types of external Shari'ah audit under ASIFI 6?
en.A: Direct: limited assurance on management's statement of compliance; Attestation: reasonable assurance on the IFI's compliance
en.B: Direct: an opinion on the effectiveness of Shari'ah controls; Attestation: an opinion on the SSB's fatwas
en.C: Direct: reasonable assurance whether the IFI has, in all material respects, complied with Shari'ah principles and rules regarding its financial arrangements, contracts and transactions; Attestation: reasonable assurance whether management's statement of compliance presents fairly the state of compliance, in all material respects
en.D: Both: absolute assurance that every transaction of the IFI complied with Shari'ah principles and rules
en.True answer: Direct: reasonable assurance whether the IFI has, in all material respects, complied with Shari'ah principles and rules regarding its financial arrangements, contracts and transactions; Attestation: reasonable assurance whether management's statement of compliance presents fairly the state of compliance, in all material respects
en.main: Para 6: in a direct engagement, the objective is to obtain REASONABLE assurance whether, based on suitable criteria, the IFI has complied in all material respects with Shari'ah principles and rules regarding its financial arrangements, contracts and transactions. Para 7: in an attestation engagement, it is reasonable assurance whether the subject matter information, i.e. management's statement of compliance, presents fairly the state of compliance in all material respects.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: A well-known Shari'ah advisory firm with highly qualified scholars, but which is not a professional accounting or auditing firm, applies to be appointed as the external Shari'ah auditor of an Islamic bank. Under ASIFI 6, how should this be evaluated?
en.A: It may be appointed, since knowledge of Shari'ah is the only requirement
en.B: It may be appointed only if the bank's SSB approves its scholars
en.C: It may be appointed only for attestation engagements
en.D: It should not be appointed: the external Shari'ah auditor is a firm with professional knowledge and competence in BOTH auditing and Shari'ah, meeting the regulator's fit and proper criteria, and the Board decided to allow only professional accounting / auditing firms
en.True answer: It should not be appointed: the external Shari'ah auditor is a firm with professional knowledge and competence in BOTH auditing and Shari'ah, meeting the regulator's fit and proper criteria, and the Board decided to allow only professional accounting / auditing firms
en.main: Para 8(d): the external Shari'ah auditor is a firm with professional knowledge and competence of auditing AND relevant Shari'ah principles and rules, meeting the fit and proper criteria of the regulator (or Central Shari'ah Board). BC18-BC20: despite requests to allow Shari'ah advisory firms, the Board decided to allow only professional accounting / auditing firms, which need to add Shari'ah capability. The external financial auditor may also be appointed.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: A conventional bank operates a stand-alone Islamic window offering Murabaha and Ijarah products. Its management argues that ASIFI 6 does not apply because the bank itself is not an Islamic bank. How should this argument be evaluated?
en.A: It is correct, because ASIFI 6 applies only to fully-fledged Islamic banks
en.B: It is incorrect, because the definition of IFIs includes stand-alone branches, divisions and windows of conventional financial institutions offering Shari'ah-compliant products and services
en.C: It is correct, unless the window holds more than 50% of the bank's total assets
en.D: It is incorrect only for Takaful windows, not for banking windows
en.True answer: It is incorrect, because the definition of IFIs includes stand-alone branches, divisions and windows of conventional financial institutions offering Shari'ah-compliant products and services
en.main: Para 8(g): IFIs include the stand-alone branches, divisions and WINDOWS of conventional financial institutions that offer products and services in line with Shari'ah principles and rules. BC16-BC17: stakeholders place the same reliance on Islamic windows as on Islamic banks, warranting the same level of independent scrutiny.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: An audit firm plans an external Shari'ah audit using its experienced financial audit team, with a Shari'ah scholar consulted only once at the end to review the draft report. Under ASIFI 6, what is the main concern with this approach?
en.A: There is no concern, provided the scholar signs the final report
en.B: The firm must use only Shari'ah scholars and no auditors on the team
en.C: The firm must ensure adequate capability in resources and knowledge of the criteria, which entails ACTIVE involvement of Shari'ah expert(s) throughout the engagement, and this involvement must be documented and stated in the report
en.D: The concern is only about fees, since Shari'ah experts increase cost
en.True answer: The firm must ensure adequate capability in resources and knowledge of the criteria, which entails ACTIVE involvement of Shari'ah expert(s) throughout the engagement, and this involvement must be documented and stated in the report
en.main: Para 11: in addition to ISQC 1, the external Shari'ah auditor shall ensure adequate capability in resources and knowledge of the criteria, entailing ACTIVE involvement of Shari'ah expert(s) THROUGHOUT the engagement. Para 36 and BC46-BC47 require documentation of their involvement (planning, supervision, review and execution), and para 38(h) requires a statement about it in the report.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: During an external Shari'ah audit, a team member proposes to report on non-compliance relating to the dress code of the IFI's employees and their personal behaviour. Under ASIFI 6, how should the underlying subject matter of a direct external Shari'ah audit be defined?
en.A: Assessing compliance of the IFI's financial arrangements, contracts and transactions with Shari'ah principles and rules for a specific period; matters such as dress code are outside the subject matter as they are not financial in nature
en.B: All aspects of the IFI's culture, behaviour and ethics, including employee dress code
en.C: Only the products approved by the SSB during the period
en.D: The IFI's financial statements and their compliance with AAOIFI accounting standards
en.True answer: Assessing compliance of the IFI's financial arrangements, contracts and transactions with Shari'ah principles and rules for a specific period; matters such as dress code are outside the subject matter as they are not financial in nature
en.main: Para 13: the underlying subject matter of a direct external Shari'ah audit comprises assessing compliance of the IFI's FINANCIAL arrangements, contracts and transactions with Shari'ah principles and rules for a specific perioBC30-BC32: the Board cited employees' dress code as an issue that may matter from a Shari'ah perspective but does not affect the compliance of contracts, and limited the subject matter to matters financial in nature.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: Under ASIFI 6, what is the correct hierarchy of the criteria (Shari'ah principles and rules) for assessment in an external Shari'ah audit, from highest to lowest?
en.A: SSB approvals and rulings; Central Shari'ah Board rulings; regulator's Shari'ah requirements; AAOIFI Shari'ah standards; AAOIFI FAS Shari'ah requirements
en.B: AAOIFI Shari'ah standards; Central Shari'ah Board rulings; regulator's Shari'ah requirements; AAOIFI FAS Shari'ah requirements; SSB approvals and rulings
en.C: Regulator's Shari'ah requirements; AAOIFI Shari'ah standards; Central Shari'ah Board rulings; SSB approvals and rulings; AAOIFI FAS Shari'ah requirements
en.D: AAOIFI Shari'ah standards; regulator's Shari'ah requirements; Central Shari'ah Board rulings; AAOIFI FAS Shari'ah requirements; SSB approvals and rulings
en.True answer: AAOIFI Shari'ah standards; regulator's Shari'ah requirements; Central Shari'ah Board rulings; AAOIFI FAS Shari'ah requirements; SSB approvals and rulings
en.main: Para 15: the criteria follow this hierarchy: (a) AAOIFI Shari'ah standards; (b) regulations of the jurisdiction's regulator insofar as they entail Shari'ah requirements; (c) rulings of the jurisdiction's Central Shari'ah Board; (d) Shari'ah-related requirements of AAOIFI FAS; and (e) approvals and rulings of the IFI's SSBC25: AAOIFI Shari'ah standards are at the top to achieve global standardisation.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: The external Shari'ah auditor and the IFI's SSB interpret a provision of an AAOIFI Shari'ah standard differently in relation to a Musharaka product. The auditor believes his interpretation is more accurate. Under ASIFI 6, whose interpretation prevails?
en.A: The external Shari'ah auditor's, since he is independent
en.B: The SSB's clarification, since in case of ambiguity regarding interpretation of items (a) to (d) of the hierarchy, the SSB's clarification shall prevail
en.C: The Central Shari'ah Board's, in all cases
en.D: Neither; the auditor must disclaim his opinion
en.True answer: The SSB's clarification, since in case of ambiguity regarding interpretation of items (a) to (d) of the hierarchy, the SSB's clarification shall prevail
en.main: Para 15 (Explanation): in case of an ambiguity identified during a compliance, audit or rating exercise regarding interpretations related to items (a) to (d), the SSB's clarification shall PREVAIL. BC26: the Board added this explanation specifically to address differences of opinion between the external Shari'ah auditor and the SSPara 36 requires such differences and conclusions to be documented.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: An IFI offers a novel digital Sukuk-trading product for which none of the criteria (AAOIFI standards, regulations, Central Shari'ah Board rulings, FAS) contain specific requirements. What should the external Shari'ah auditor do, and what if he still cannot conclude on the suitability of the criteria?
en.A: Apply his own Shari'ah judgement as the criteria; if uncertain, issue a qualified opinion
en.B: Exclude the product from the audit scope without disclosure
en.C: Interact with the IFI's Shari'ah supervisor(s) to form the details of the criteria; if still unable to conclude on suitability, either withdraw from the engagement or disclaim the opinion
en.D: Rely on the IFI's Shari'ah compliance department as the criteria; if uncertain, issue an adverse opinion
en.True answer: Interact with the IFI's Shari'ah supervisor(s) to form the details of the criteria; if still unable to conclude on suitability, either withdraw from the engagement or disclaim the opinion
en.main: Para 17: where nothing specific is available in the criteria, the external Shari'ah auditor shall interact with the IFI's Shari'ah supervisor(s) and form the details of the criteriPara 18: if unable to conclude on the suitability of criteria, he shall either WITHDRAW or DISCLAIM. BC34: otherwise the opinion might rest on the auditor's own judgement, jeopardising its adequacy.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: During an external Shari'ah audit, the auditor finds that late-payment penalties amounting to only 0.01% of total income were credited to income instead of charity. The audit manager argues that the item is immaterial and need not be considereUnder ASIFI 6, which view is correct?
en.A: Materiality must consider qualitative as well as quantitative factors; Shari'ah non-compliant income must be eliminated irrespective of being quantitatively immaterial, and such qualitatively significant observations are reported through the long form report
en.B: The manager is correct, since the same materiality threshold as the financial statement audit applies
en.C: The item must cause an adverse opinion, since any Shari'ah non-compliance is pervasive
en.D: The item is relevant only if it exceeds the tolerable deviation rate set for the financial audit
en.True answer: Materiality must consider qualitative as well as quantitative factors; Shari'ah non-compliant income must be eliminated irrespective of being quantitatively immaterial, and such qualitatively significant observations are reported through the long form report
en.main: Paras 21-22: materiality has quantitative and qualitative aspects, including the severity of an observation from the Shari'ah perspective and its significance to specific stakeholders; values may differ from a financial statement audit. BC36: Shari'ah non-compliant income shall mandatorily be eliminated, irrespective of being quantitatively immaterial. BC37: the long form report ensures that quantitatively immaterial yet qualitatively significant issues are reported.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: An IFI's board asks the external Shari'ah auditor to include in the short form report a formal opinion on the effectiveness of the IFI's Shari'ah internal controls and governance framework. How does ASIFI 6 address the auditor's work on internal controls?
en.A: The auditor expresses a separate reasonable assurance opinion on the effectiveness of internal controls in the short form report
en.B: The auditor does not consider internal controls, since the engagement focuses only on transactions
en.C: The auditor tests internal controls only if the regulator requires it, and reports to shareholders
en.D: The auditor considers and tests internal controls (including governance) relevant to Shari'ah compliance to design appropriate procedures, but NOT to express an opinion on their effectiveness; comments on internal control are included in the long form report
en.True answer: The auditor considers and tests internal controls (including governance) relevant to Shari'ah compliance to design appropriate procedures, but NOT to express an opinion on their effectiveness; comments on internal control are included in the long form report
en.main: Para 23: in assessing the risks of material non-compliance, the external Shari'ah auditor shall consider and test internal controls (including the governance framework) relevant to Shari'ah compliance in order to design appropriate procedures, but NOT for the purpose of expressing an opinion on the effectiveness of such controls. Comments on internal control are included in the long form report (para 40).

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question:
Which of the following statements on sampling in an external Shari'ah audit are consistent with ASIFI 6?
i. Sample sizes are determined applying statistical approaches together with judgement regarding the risk of Shari'ah non-compliance.
ii. When instances of Shari'ah non-compliance are identified, sample sizes shall be increased adequately.
iii. For areas sensitive to qualitative materiality, selection takes into account the qualitative aspects of individual items in the population.
iv. Sampling must always be purely statistical, with no judgement, to ensure objectivity.
en.A: i and iv
en.B: i, ii and iii
en.C: ii, iii and iv
en.D: i, ii, iii and iv
en.True answer: i, ii and iii
en.main: Paras 24-25: the auditor determines whether and how to sample based on inherent and control risks of non-compliance and materiality (especially qualitative); sample sizes use statistical approaches AND judgement (i); sample sizes are increased adequately when non-compliance is identified (ii); qualitative aspects of individual items are considered in sensitive areas (iii). BC40: a judgemental approach applies to areas affected by qualitative factors, so (iv) is incorrect.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: The external Shari'ah auditor plans to sign the report on 20 March 20X6. Management offers to date its written representations 25 March 20X6, after the report, and to exclude events after the year enSeparately, management refuses to provide a representation on the adequacy of Shari'ah controls over product approvals. What is correct under ASIFI 6?
en.A: The representations may be dated after the report; the refusal has no effect on the opinion
en.B: The representations should be dated at the year end; the refusal leads to a qualified opinion
en.C: The representations should be dated as near as practicable to, but not after, the report date and include significant subsequent events; refusal to provide a requested representation requires a disclaimer of opinion
en.D: Written representations are not required in a direct engagement
en.True answer: The representations should be dated as near as practicable to, but not after, the report date and include significant subsequent events; refusal to provide a requested representation requires a disclaimer of opinion
en.main: Para 27: the date of written representations shall be as near as practicable to the report date, but NOT after it, and all significant events subsequent to the period covered shall be includePara 26: representations emphasise the adequacy of internal control and governance for Shari'ah compliance, including product approvals. Para 30: if the IFI refuses to provide one or more requested written representations, the auditor shall DISCLAIM his opinion.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: In a direct external Shari'ah audit, the auditor finds that throughout the year the IFI systematically calculated and distributed profits to unrestricted investment accountholders in breach of the SSB-approved Mudaraba terms, affecting the entire IAH pool. The IFI refuses corrective measures. How should the auditor report?
en.A: Unmodified opinion, with the matter reported only in the long form report
en.B: Unmodified opinion with an emphasis of matter paragraph
en.C: Disclaimer of opinion, since the matter involves Shari'ah interpretation
en.D: A modified opinion, which given the pervasive material non-compliance would be adverse, with a clear description of the reasons for the modification in the report
en.True answer: A modified opinion, which given the pervasive material non-compliance would be adverse, with a clear description of the reasons for the modification in the report
en.main: Para 41: if the auditor concludes that there is material non-compliance with Shari'ah principles and rules, the opinion shall be modified in the form of a qualified, adverse or disclaimer of opinion, as appropriate. Here the non-compliance is material and pervasive and the auditor has sufficient evidence, so an adverse opinion is appropriate. Para 42: the report shall contain a clear description of the reasons for the modification.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: An IFI has (a) an internal Shari'ah audit function reporting to the board's audit and governance committee, and (b) a Shari'ah compliance department reporting to the CEO. To what extent can the external Shari'ah auditor use their work under ASIFI 6?
en.A: The internal Shari'ah audit's work may be used to complement the auditor's work if assessed as independent of management and reliable; the Shari'ah compliance department's work may be considered as part of effective internal controls but not as a part replacement for the auditor's work
en.B: Both may be used equally to replace part of the auditor's work, since both deal with Shari'ah compliance
en.C: Neither may be used, since the external Shari'ah auditor must perform all work independently
en.D: Only the Shari'ah compliance department's work may be used, since it performs daily compliance checks
en.True answer: The internal Shari'ah audit's work may be used to complement the auditor's work if assessed as independent of management and reliable; the Shari'ah compliance department's work may be considered as part of effective internal controls but not as a part replacement for the auditor's work
en.main: Para 31: the primary criterion for using such work is its relative INDEPENDENCE from management; Shari'ah-related management functions, e.g. the Shari'ah compliance department, shall not be used as a part replacement for the auditor's work, though they may be considered as part of effective internal controls. Paras 32-33: for independent and reliable functions, the auditor reviews their reports (and working papers where necessary) and determines the impact on the nature, timing and extent of work. BC41-BC43 confirm this.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: After testing controls, the external Shari'ah auditor concludes that residual risk remains high regarding the allocation of profit between the IFI as Mudarib and the investment accountholders. What should the auditor do under ASIFI 6?
en.A: Accept the residual risk, since controls have already been tested
en.B: Issue an adverse opinion immediately
en.C: Obtain further evidence and perform testing of details, such as re-computation and analytical review of the profit and loss distribution to investment accountholders; if the risk still cannot be reduced to an acceptably low level, consider the impact on the report
en.D: Rely on the SSB's report on profit distribution instead of performing further work
en.True answer: Obtain further evidence and perform testing of details, such as re-computation and analytical review of the profit and loss distribution to investment accountholders; if the risk still cannot be reduced to an acceptably low level, consider the impact on the report
en.main: Para 34: the auditor assesses residual risk not adequately addressed and considers obtaining further evidence and performing testing of details, including analytical and detailed verification, physical inspections, confirmations, and re-computation and analytical review of quantitative data, e.g. profit and loss distribution to investment accountholders. If unable to reduce the risk to an acceptably low level, he considers the impact on the report. BC44-BC45 define residual risk and testing of details.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question:
Which of the following statements regarding the external Shari'ah auditor's report under ASIFI 6 are correct?
i. It is addressed to the shareholders of the IFI, unless otherwise required by the regulators of the jurisdiction.
ii. It is dated no earlier than the date on which sufficient appropriate evidence has been obtained, including the report of the IFI's Shari'ah supervisor(s).
iii. It includes a statement about the involvement of subject matter (Shari'ah) experts.
iv. It includes the full long form report as an appendix for the benefit of all stakeholders.
en.A: i and iv
en.B: i, ii and iii
en.C: ii, iii and iv
en.D: i, ii, iii and iv
en.True answer: i, ii and iii
en.main: Para 38 lists the basic elements: (b) addressee, the shareholders unless otherwise required by regulators (i); (j) date no earlier than obtaining sufficient appropriate evidence including the SSB's report (ii); (h) a statement on the involvement of Shari'ah experts (iii); and (l) a STATEMENT that a long form report is being issued to those charged with governance. The long form report itself is not appended or made public (para 40, BC22), so (iv) is incorrect.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question: In an attestation external Shari'ah audit, management's statement of compliance fairly and adequately describes a material non-compliance: certain Ijarah contracts did not transfer ownership risk to the IFI. The auditor agrees that the statement presents fairly the state of compliance. How should the auditor report?
en.A: Issue a qualified opinion because of the material non-compliance
en.B: Issue an adverse opinion, since the IFI did not comply with Shari'ah principles
en.C: Issue an unmodified opinion without mentioning the non-compliance, since it is already disclosed by management
en.D: Issue an unmodified opinion, but include a reference to the material non-compliance adequately described by management in the statement of compliance
en.True answer: Issue an unmodified opinion, but include a reference to the material non-compliance adequately described by management in the statement of compliance
en.main: Para 38(m): in an attestation engagement, WITHOUT modifying the opinion, the report includes a reference to any material non-compliance adequately described by management in the subject matter information. BC51-BC53: the opinion concerns the fairness of management's statement, which here is fair; but to avoid users wrongly assuming there was no non-compliance, the report must expressly highlight it.

en.Theme: AAOIFI Auditing Standard No. 06: External Shari'ah Audit
en.Question:
Which of the following statements regarding the long form report under ASIFI 6 are correct?
i. It is issued alongside the short form report and addressed to those charged with governance.
ii. It primarily contains key audit matters and observations, particularly material observations resolved through adjustment, charity, reversals or other corrective measures.
iii. It is not addressed to shareholders or stakeholders at large, given the sensitivity of Shari'ah compliance matters, though it may be shared with regulators as needed.
iv. It replaces the short form report when material non-compliances are identified.
en.A: i, ii and iii
en.B: i and iv
en.C: ii, iii and iv
en.D: i, ii, iii and iv
en.True answer: i, ii and iii
en.main: Para 40: a long form report shall be issued ALONGSIDE the short form report, addressed to those charged with governance, primarily containing key audit matters and observations, particularly material observations resolved through adjustment, charity, reversals or other corrective measures (i, ii). BC22: it is not addressed to shareholders or the public, given the sensitivities, but may be shared with regulators (iii). It never replaces the short form report (iv is incorrect).

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 19: Shariat nazorati hay'ati: Tayinlash va tarkib
uz.Question: Islom tijorat banki yangi Shariat boshqaruvi tizimini shakllantirmoqdDirektorlar kengashi qarorlar qabul qilishda tezkorlikni ta'minlash maqsadida asosiy Shariat nazorati hay'ati (SNH/SStarkibiga ikki nafar katta fiqh olimini tayinlashni taklif qilmoqdAAOIFI GS 19 standartiga ko'ra, mazkur tarkibga nisbatan quyidagi tasdiqlardan qaysi biri to'g'ri?
uz.A: Tuzilma to'liq muvofiq, basharti tayinlangan har ikki olim ham Fiqh al-muomalat sohasida kamida 15 yillik amaliy tajribaga ega bo'lsa.
uz.B: Tuzilma talablarga nomuvofiq, chunki SNH kamida uch nafar Fiqh al-muomalat bo'yicha ixtisoslashgan shariat olimidan iborat bo'lishi shart.
uz.C: Agar bank texnik masalalarda hay'atga ko'maklashish uchun moliya bozori bo'yicha katta maslahatchi tayinlasa, mazkur tuzilma muvofiq hisoblanadi.
uz.D: Aksiyadorlarning navbatdan tashqari umumiy yig'ilishida (EGM) oldindan yozma rozilik olinmaguncha, tuzilma nomuvofiq bo'lib qoladi.
uz.True answer: Tuzilma talablarga nomuvofiq, chunki SNH kamida uch nafar Fiqh al-muomalat bo'yicha ixtisoslashgan shariat olimidan iborat bo'lishi shart.
uz.main: Asos: AAOIFI GS 19, 7-band ("Har bir muassasa Fiqh al-muomalat bo'yicha ixtisoslashgan kamida uch nafar shariat olimidan iborat SNHga ega bo'lishi lozim...").

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 19: Shariat nazorati hay'ati: Tayinlash va tarkib
uz.Question: Islomiy moliya muassasasi (IMM) kompyuter fanlari (Computer Science) bo'yicha magistr darajasiga ega, ammo islom huquqshunosligi (fiqh) bo'yicha rasmiy diplomga ega bo'lmagan fintex mutaxassisini SNH maslahatchisi sifatida jalb qilmoqchi. Rahbariyat ushbu mutaxassisni SNH maslahatchisi etib tayinlamoqchi. GS 19 standartiga ko'ra, taklif etilgan ushbu tayinlov qanday baholanadi?
uz.A: Haqiqiy emas, chunki SNHda xizmat qiluvchi barcha a'zolar va maslahatchilar islom huquqshunosligi yoki Fiqh bo'yicha rasmiy magistrlik darajasiga ega bo'lishi talab etiladi.
uz.B: Haqiqiy, basharti fintex mutaxassisiga raqamli moliyaviy mahsulotlarga oid barcha hay'at qarorlarida to'liq ovoz berish huquqi berilsa.
uz.C: Haqiqiy, basharti ushbu shaxs musulmon bo'lsa, o'z sohasida tan olingan ekspert bo'lsa va Shariat tamoyillari bo'yicha tayanch bilimlarga ega bo'lsa.
uz.D: Haqiqiy emas, chunki GS 19 moliya yoki yuridik ma'lumotga ega bo'lmagan shaxslarning har qanday maqomda maslahatchi bo'lib faoliyat yuritishini qat'iyan taqiqlaydi.
uz.True answer: Haqiqiy, basharti ushbu shaxs musulmon bo'lsa, o'z sohasida tan olingan ekspert bo'lsa va Shariat tamoyillari bo'yicha tayanch bilimlarga ega bo'lsa.
uz.main: Asos: AAOIFI GS 19 talablariga ko'ra, SNH maslahatchilari ovoz berish huquqisiz jalb etilishi mumkin bo'lib, ular o'z sohasining malakali mutaxassisi, musulmon va Shariat asoslaridan xabardor bo'lishi yetarlidir.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 19: Shariat nazorati hay'ati: Tayinlash va tarkib
uz.Question: Islom bankining Direktorlar kengashi (boshqaruv vakolati yuklatilgan shaxslar — TCWG sifatidaksiyadorlarga havola etmasdan, bevosita ijroiya qarori orqali SNHning uch nafar a'zosini tayinlaydi va ularning haq to'lash paketlarini tasdiqlaydi. GS 19 standartiga ko'ra, mazkur jarayonning huquqiy maqomi qanday?
uz.A: To'liq haqiqiy, chunki TCWG korporativ boshqaruv tayinlovlarini aksiyadorlar aralashuvisiz amalga oshirish bo'yicha to'liq ijro vakolatiga ega.
uz.B: Haqiqiy, basharti Tartibga soluvchi va nazorat qiluvchi organ (RStayinlovdan keyin 30 kun ichida rasmiy ratifikatsiya xatini chiqarsa.
uz.C: Haqiqiy emas, chunki faqat Tartibga soluvchi va nazorat qiluvchi organ (RSSNH olimlarini tanlash va tayinlash qonuniy vakolatiga ega.
uz.D: Haqiqiy emas, chunki SNH a'zolari TCWG tavsiyasiga binoan muassasa aksiyadorlarining umumiy yig'ilishida tasdiqlanishi shart.
uz.True answer: Haqiqiy emas, chunki SNH a'zolari TCWG tavsiyasiga binoan muassasa aksiyadorlarining umumiy yig'ilishida tasdiqlanishi shart.
uz.main: Asos: AAOIFI GS 19, 12-band ("SNH a'zolari TCWG tavsiyasiga asosan aksiyadorlarning umumiy yig'ilishida tasdiqlanishi lozim").

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 19: Shariat nazorati hay'ati: Tayinlash va tarkib
uz.Question: Islom bankida favqulodda vaziyat yuz berib, avvalgi barcha SNH a'zolari bir vaqtda iste'foga chiqdi. Bank mahalliy bank nazorati organi tomonidan belgilangan muddat ichida yangi SNHni tayinlay olmadi. AAOIFI GS 19 standartiga ko'ra, Tartibga soluvchi va nazorat qiluvchi organ (RSqanday chora ko'rishi mumkin?
uz.A: Islom bankining faoliyat litsenziyasini zudlik bilan chaqirib olish va majburiy tugatish (likvidatsiyjarayonini boshlash.
uz.B: Muassasani zudlik bilan an'anaviy tijorat bankiga aylantirish to'g'risida buyruq berish.
uz.C: O'z ixtiyoriga ko'ra vaqtinchalik SNH tayinlash, bunda barcha tegishli xarajatlar bevosita muassasa zimmasiga yuklatiladi.
uz.D: Bosh risk ma'muri (CRO) va Ichki shariat auditoridan vaqtinchalik SNHning barcha vazifalarini birgalikda bajarishlarini talab qilish.
uz.True answer: O'z ixtiyoriga ko'ra vaqtinchalik SNH tayinlash, bunda barcha tegishli xarajatlar bevosita muassasa zimmasiga yuklatiladi.
uz.main: Asos: AAOIFI GS 19, 15-band ("Agar muassasa RSA tomonidan belgilangan muddatda SNH tayinlamasa, RSA o'z ixtiyoriga ko'ra vaqtinchalik SNH tayinlashi mumkin. Barcha xarajatlar... muassasa tomonidan qoplanadi").

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 19: Shariat nazorati hay'ati: Tayinlash va tarkib
uz.Question: Xalqaro bankning islomiy darchasi (Islamic window) yangi tanlangan SNH a'zolari bilan xizmat ko'rsatish shartnomalarini rasmiylashtirmoqchi. AAOIFI GS 19 standartida shartnoma muddatining davomiyligi bo'yicha qanday talablar belgilangan?
uz.A: Ijroiya rahbariyat ta'siridan to'liq operatsion mustaqillikni ta'minlash maqsadida muddatsiz shartnomalar tuziladi.
uz.B: Kengash huzuridagi Audit qo'mitasi tomonidan har yili baholanishi sharti bilan bir yillik uzaytiriladigan shartnomalar.
uz.C: Kamida uch yil va ko'pi bilan besh yildan oshmagan muddatga xizmat ko'rsatish shartnomalari.
uz.D: Shariat boshqaruvi nazoratida uzoq muddatli barqarorlikni ta'minlash uchun o'n yillik uzaytirilmaydigan qat'iy shartnomalar.
uz.True answer: Kamida uch yil va ko'pi bilan besh yildan oshmagan muddatga xizmat ko'rsatish shartnomalari.
uz.main: Asos: AAOIFI GS 19, 16-band ("...kamida uch yil, lekin ko'pi bilan besh yildan oshmagan muddatga xizmat ko'rsatish shartnomasi").

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 19: Shariat nazorati hay'ati: Tayinlash va tarkib
uz.Question: Shariat olimini SNHga tayinlashda 'Munosib va maqbul' (Fit and Proper) mezonlarini baholash maqsadida muassasa bir nechta nomzodlarni ko'rib chiqmoqdQaysi nomzodning profili AAOIFI GS 19 bo'yicha belgilangan minimal talablarga to'liq javob beradi?
uz.A: Nomzod A: Fiqh bo'yicha magistr darajasiga ega, Fiqh al-muomalat sohasida 12 yillik tajribaga ega hamda arab tili va mahalliy ish yuritish tilini mukammal biladi.
uz.B: Nomzod B: Iqtisodiyot bo'yicha bakalavr darajasiga ega va islomiy bank darchasi operatsiyalarida 2 yillik amaliy tajribaga ega.
uz.C: Nomzod C: Yaqin Sharq tijorat huquqi tizimlari bo'yicha 20 yillik ilmiy-tadqiqot tajribasiga ega bo'lgan musulmon bo'lmagan huquqshunos olim.
uz.D: Nomzod D: Fan doktori (Ph.D.) darajasiga ega, biroq e'tirof etilgan ilmiy konsensusga (ijmogto'g'ridan-to'g'ri zid keluvchi g'ayrioddiy (shaz) fatvolarni ochiq ilgari suruvchi shariat olimi.
uz.True answer: Nomzod A: Fiqh bo'yicha magistr darajasiga ega, Fiqh al-muomalat sohasida 12 yillik tajribaga ega hamda arab tili va mahalliy ish yuritish tilini mukammal biladi.
uz.main: Asos: AAOIFI GS 19, 18-band (Musulmon bo'lish, Shariat/Fiqh bo'yicha kamida magistr darajasi, Fiqh al-muomalat bo'yicha kamida 10 yillik tajriba, arab va biznes tilini yaxshi bilish hamda konsensusga zid qarashlarga ega bo'lmaslik).

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 19: Shariat nazorati hay'ati: Tayinlash va tarkib
uz.Question: SNH a'zosi bo'lgan olim moliyaviy yil davomida islom bankining rejalashtirilgan barcha choraklik majlislarida uzrli sababsiz qatnashmadi. AAOIFI GS 19 standartiga ko'ra, boshqaruv nuqtai nazaridan qanday oqibat yuzaga keladi?
uz.A: Olimning yillik xizmat haqi avtomatik tarzda 50% ga kamaytiriladi, biroq hay'atdagi a'zoligi saqlanib qoladi.
uz.B: Olim majlislarda asossiz qatnashmaganligi sababli diskvalifikatsiya qilinishi (hay'at a'zoligidan chetlatilishi) xavfi ostida qoladi.
uz.C: Bosh ijrochi direktor (CEO) unga rasmiy hayfsan berish va tayinlov muddatini uzaytirish vakolatiga ega bo'ladi.
uz.D: Modomiki olim yil yakunida yillik Shariat hisobotini imzolasa, hech qanday rasmiy intizomiy chora qo'llanilmaydi.
uz.True answer: Olim majlislarda asossiz qatnashmaganligi sababli diskvalifikatsiya qilinishi (hay'at a'zoligidan chetlatilishi) xavfi ostida qoladi.
uz.main: Asos: AAOIFI GS 19, 21(b)-band (Diskvalifikatsiya mezoni: "uzrli sababsiz bir yil davomida minimal belgilangan majlislar sonida ishtirok etmaslik").

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 19: Shariat nazorati hay'ati: Tayinlash va tarkib
uz.Question: Muvofiqlikni baholashda yoki mavhumliklarni hal qilishda AAOIFI GS 19 bo'yicha belgilangan 'Shariat tamoyillari va qoidalari' iyerarxiyasini quyidagilardan qaysi biri to'g'ri ifodalaydi?
uz.A: Markaziy bank qoidalari > Mahalliy urf (Urf) > AAOIFI Shariat standartlari > Bankning ichki SNH qarorlari.
uz.B: Boshqaruv rahbariyati farmoyishlari > Ichki SNH qarorlari > AAOIFI standartlari > Moliyaviy hisobotning xalqaro standartlari (IFRS).
uz.C: AAOIFI Shariat standartlari > Regulyatorning shariat talablari > Markaziy shariat kengashi qarorlari > AAOIFI FAS shariat talablari > Muassasa SNH qarorlari.
uz.D: Muassasaning ichki SNH qarorlari barcha holatlarda istisnosiz milliy regulyator shariat kengashining qarorlaridan ustun turadi.
uz.True answer: AAOIFI Shariat standartlari > Regulyatorning shariat talablari > Markaziy shariat kengashi qarorlari > AAOIFI FAS shariat talablari > Muassasa SNH qarorlari.
uz.main: Asos: AAOIFI GS 19, 5(b)-band (Shariat me'yorlari iyerarxiyasi: i. AAOIFI Shariat standartlari; ii. Regulyator shariat talablari; iii. Markaziy shariat kengashi qarorlari; iv. AAOIFI FAS talablari; v. Muassasa SNH fatvolari).

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 19: Shariat nazorati hay'ati: Tayinlash va tarkib
uz.Question:
IMM boshqaruv sifatini oshirish maqsadida o'z SNH tarkibida xilma-xillikni ta'minlashga intiladi. AAOIFI GS 19 ga muvofiq, SNH tarkibida qaysi elementlar aks etishi maqsadga muvofiq hisoblanadi?

i. Mamlakatdagi turli fiqhiy mazhablar (mazohivakilligi.
ii. Islom moliyasiga tegishli turli texnik ekspertiza sohalarining vakilligi.
iii. Ham tajribali (senior), ham yosh (junior) olimlarning kiritilishi.
uz.A: faqat i
uz.B: faqat i va ii
uz.C: faqat ii va iii
uz.D: i, ii va iii
uz.True answer: i, ii va iii
uz.main: Asos: AAOIFI GS 19 tavsiyalari (SNH tarkibida amaldagi asosiy mazhablar, tajribali hamda yosh shariat mutaxassislari va moliyaviy-texnik bilimga ega mutaxassislar muvozanati rag'batlantiriladi).

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 19: Shariat nazorati hay'ati: Tayinlash va tarkib
uz.Question: AAOIFI GS 19 standartiga ko'ra, quyidagi harakatlardan qaysi biri faoliyat yuritayotgan SNH a'zosini diskvalifikatsiya qilish (vakolatini to'xtatish) uchun yetarli asos hisoblanadi?
uz.A: A'zo ichki yig'ilishda taklif etilayotgan Sukuk tuzilmasi bo'yicha alohida (qarshi) fikr bildirsa.
uz.B: A'zo mijozlarning maxfiy ma'lumotlaridan shaxsiy manfaati yo'lida yoki bankning raqobatbardoshligiga zarar yetkazadigan tarzda foydalansa.
uz.C: A'zo zamonaviy moliyaviy instrumentlar (derivativlar) bo'yicha klassik fiqh qarashlarini tahlil qiluvchi ilmiy jurnal maqolasini chop etsa.
uz.D: A'zo ijroiya rahbariyatiga bankning yillik xayriya va vaqf fondlariga ajratmalarini oshirishni tavsiya qilsa.
uz.True answer: A'zo mijozlarning maxfiy ma'lumotlaridan shaxsiy manfaati yo'lida yoki bankning raqobatbardoshligiga zarar yetkazadigan tarzda foydalansa.
uz.main: Asos: AAOIFI GS 19, 21(g)-band (Diskvalifikatsiya: "muassasa yoki mijozlarning maxfiy va imtiyozli ma'lumotlaridan shaxsiy manfaat yoki raqobat manfaatlariga zid tarzda noqonuniy foydalanish").

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Auditor islomiy moliya muassasasi hisobotini yakunlamoqdRahbariyat moliyaviy hisobotlarni tayyorlagan va muassasa faoliyatini Shariat qoidalari va tamoyillariga muvofiq yuritish majburiyatini o'z zimmasiga olgan. Kirish (introductory) paragrafida qaysi bayonot aks etishi kerak?
uz.A: Rahbariyat moliyaviy hisobotlarni tayyorlash uchun, auditor esa barcha operatsiyalarda Shariatga muvofiqlikni ta'minlash uchun javobgardir.
uz.B: Rahbariyat moliyaviy hisobotlar va faoliyatni Shariat qoidalari va tamoyillariga muvofiq yuritish majburiyati uchun javobgardir, auditor esa o'tkazilgan audit asosida fikr (xulosbildirish uchun javobgardir.
uz.C: Rahbariyat moliyaviy hisobotlar uchun javobgardir, Shariat nazorati hay'ati esa auditorlik muolajalari asosida auditorlik xulosasini bildirish uchun javobgardir.
uz.D: Rahbariyat moliyaviy hisobotlar va hisob siyosati uchun javobgardir, auditor esa rahbariyatning barcha Shariat talablariga rioya qilganligini aniqlash uchun javobgardir.
uz.True answer: Rahbariyat moliyaviy hisobotlar va faoliyatni Shariat qoidalari va tamoyillariga muvofiq yuritish majburiyati uchun javobgardir, auditor esa o'tkazilgan audit asosida fikr (xulosbildirish uchun javobgardir.
uz.main: ASIFI - 2: 9-paragraf. Hisobotda moliyaviy hisobotlar va muassasaning Shariat qoidalari va tamoyillariga muvofiq faoliyat yuritish majburiyati moliya muassasasi rahbariyatining mas'uliyati ekanligi, auditorning mas'uliyati esa o'tkazilgan audit asosida moliyaviy hisobotlar bo'yicha fikr bildirishdan iborat ekanligi ko'rsatilishi kerak.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Auditor o'z milliy audit amaliyotiga ega bo'lgan mamlakatda faoliyat yurituvchi islomiy moliya muassasasi uchun audit ko'lami (scope) paragrafini loyihalashtirmoqdASIFI 2 talablarini qaysi ta'rif eng to'g'ri aks ettiradi?
uz.A: Audit AAOIFI buxgalteriya hisobi standartlari va tegishli milliy amaliyotlarga muvofiq o'tkazildi, basharti bu amaliyotlar moliya muassasasining ichki siyosatiga mos kelsa.
uz.B: Audit ASIFI standartlari hamda tegishli milliy standartlar yoki amaliyotlarga muvofiq holda, basharti ular Shariat qoidalari va tamoyillariga zid bo'lmasa, o'tkazildi.
uz.C: Audit auditorga nisbatan qo'llaniladigan milliy audit standartlari hamda Shariat nazorati hay'ati tomonidan chiqarilgan har qanday buxgalteriya standartlariga muvofiq o'tkazildi.
uz.D: Audit xalqaro audit standartlari va tegishli milliy qonunchilikka muvofiq, basharti rahbariyat bu standartlarni muassasa uchun maqbul deb hisoblasa, o'tkazildi.
uz.True answer: Audit ASIFI standartlari hamda tegishli milliy standartlar yoki amaliyotlarga muvofiq holda, basharti ular Shariat qoidalari va tamoyillariga zid bo'lmasa, o'tkazildi.
uz.main: ASIFI - 2: 12-paragraf. Hisobot audit qamrovini (ko'lamini) tushuntirib berishi lozim. Unda tekshiruv ASIFI standartlari hamda tegishli milliy standartlar yoki amaliyotlarga muvofiq, agar ular Shariat qoidalari va tamoyillariga zid kelmasa, amalga oshirilganligi qayd etilishi shart.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Auditorlik hisobotini tayyorlash jarayonida auditor bajarilgan ish hajmini qanday tasvirlashni hal qilmoqdQaysi bayonot hisobotda tavsiflanishi talab etiladigan audit tartib-taomillarini eng aniq aks ettiradi?
uz.A: Audit har bir operatsiyani ko'rib chiqish, har bir buxgalteriya yozuvini tekshirish, rahbariyatning barcha qarorlarini qayta baholash va moliyaviy hisobotdagi har bir ochiqlamani tasdiqlashni o'z ichiga oldi.
uz.B: Audit muhim operatsiyalarni tekshirish, rahbariyatning hisob-kitoblarini (baholarini) ma'qullash, ichki siyosatlarni ko'rib chiqish va muassasaning umumiy moliyaviy natijalarini baholashni o'z ichiga oldi.
uz.C: Audit barcha muhim qoldiqlarni tasdiqlash, har bir hisob siyosatini ko'rib chiqish, barcha operatsiyalarni testdan o'tkazish va muassasaning qonuniy talablarga muvofiqligini baholashni o'z ichiga oldi.
uz.D: Audit dalillarni tanlanma (test) asosida tekshirish, hisob tamoyillari va rahbariyat tomonidan qilingan muhim hisobiy baholarni baholash hamda umumiy moliyaviy hisobot taqdimotini baholashni o'z ichiga oldi.
uz.True answer: Audit dalillarni tanlanma (test) asosida tekshirish, hisob tamoyillari va rahbariyat tomonidan qilingan muhim hisobiy baholarni baholash hamda umumiy moliyaviy hisobot taqdimotini baholashni o'z ichiga oldi.
uz.main: 14-paragraf — Hisobotda audit dalillarni tanlanma asosida tekshirish, hisob tamoyillari va rahbariyatning muhim baholarini ko'rib chiqish hamda moliyaviy hisobotlarning umumiy taqdimotini baholashni o'z ichiga olganligi bayon qilinishi kerak.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Islomiy moliya muassasasi o'z moliyaviy hisobotlarini belgilangan moliyaviy hisobot tizimi asosida tayyorlaydi. Auditni yakunlagach, auditor hisobotlar ushbu tizimga muvofiq haqqoniy va xolis (to'g'ri) tasavvur beradi degan xulosaga keladi. Odatda qanday auditorlik fikri (xulosasi) bildirilishi lozim?
uz.A: Shartli-ijobiy xulosa (qualified opinion), chunki auditor rahbariyat tomonidan qabul qilingan har bir hisobiy mulohazani hisobotda ko'rsatishi shart.
uz.B: Salbiy xulosa (adverse opinion), chunki moliyaviy hisobotlarni tayyorlash uchun rahbariyat javobgar bo'lib qoladi.
uz.C: Qaydsiz / toza xulosa (unqualified opinion), chunki moliyaviy hisobotlar belgilangan moliyaviy hisobot tizimiga muvofiq haqqoniy va xolis tasavvur beradi.
uz.D: Fikr bildirishdan bosh tortish (disclaimer of opinion), chunki auditor rahbariyatning buxgalteriya hisobiy baholari va mulohazalari bo'yicha kafolat bera olmaydi.
uz.True answer: Qaydsiz / toza xulosa (unqualified opinion), chunki moliyaviy hisobotlar belgilangan moliyaviy hisobot tizimiga muvofiq haqqoniy va xolis tasavvur beradi.
uz.main: 27-paragraf — Auditor moliyaviy hisobotlar belgilangan moliyaviy hisobot tizimiga muvofiq haqqoniy va xolis tasavvur beradi degan xulosaga kelganida qaydsiz (tozxulosa (unqualified opinion) ifodalanishi lozim.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Auditor barcha zarur audit tartib-taomillarini 20-mart kuni yakunladi. Rahbariyat moliyaviy hisobotlarni 24-mart kuni imzoladi. Auditor audit ishlari shu sanada tugaganligi sababli hisobotga 20-mart sanasini qo'yishni taklif qilmoqdAuditor qanday yo'l tutishi kerak?
uz.A: Hisobotga 20-mart sanasini qo'yish kerak, chunki audit tartib-taomillari rahbariyat hisobotlarni imzolashidan oldin yakunlangan.
uz.B: Hisobotga 24-mart sanasini qo'yish kerak, chunki auditor hisobot sanasini rahbariyat tomonidan moliyaviy hisobotlar imzolangan yoki tasdiqlangan sanadan oldingi sana bilan sanalamasligi shart.
uz.C: Hisobotga 20-mart sanasini qo'yish kerak, chunki auditorning hisobdorlik mas'uliyati yetarli audit dalillari to'plangan paytdan boshlanadi.
uz.D: Faqat rahbariyat hisobot davriga moslikni ta'minlash uchun keyingi sanani so'ragan taqdirdagina hisobotga 24-mart sanasini qo'yish kerak.
uz.True answer: Hisobotga 24-mart sanasini qo'yish kerak, chunki auditor hisobot sanasini rahbariyat tomonidan moliyaviy hisobotlar imzolangan yoki tasdiqlangan sanadan oldingi sana bilan sanalamasligi shart.
uz.main: 24-paragraf — Auditor auditorlik hisobotiga moliyaviy hisobotlar rahbariyat tomonidan imzolangan yoki ma'qullangan sanadan oldingi sanani qo'ymasligi lozim.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Islomiy moliya muassasasi sud jarayoni (huquqiy masalbilan bog'liq jiddiy noaniqlikni ochiqlagan. Bu noaniqlik uzluksiz faoliyat (going concern) muammosiga taalluqli emas va uning yakuniy yechimi kelajakdagi voqealarga bog'liq. Auditor ushbu masalani moliyaviy hisobot foydalanuvchilari uchun muhim deb hisoblaydi. Auditor nima qilishi mumkin?
uz.A: Auditorlik xulosasini o'zgartirmagan (modifikatsiya qilmagan) holda, e'tiborni ushbu noaniqlikka qaratish uchun alohida e'tibor qaratiladigan masalalar (emphasis of matter) xatboshisini qo'shish.
uz.B: Shartli-ijobiy xulosa bildirish, chunki har qanday jiddiy noaniqlik auditorlik fikrini o'zgartirishni talab qiladi.
uz.C: Salbiy xulosa bildirish, chunki noaniqlik natijasi hisobot sanasidan keyin sodir bo'ladigan voqealarga bog'liq.
uz.D: Fikr bildirishdan bosh tortish, chunki auditor hisobot sanasida noaniqlikning yakuniy natijasini aniqlay olmaydi.
uz.True answer: Auditorlik xulosasini o'zgartirmagan (modifikatsiya qilmagan) holda, e'tiborni ushbu noaniqlikka qaratish uchun alohida e'tibor qaratiladigan masalalar (emphasis of matter) xatboshisini qo'shish.
uz.main: 32-paragraf — Agar uzluksiz faoliyat muammosidan tashqari, yechimi kelajakdagi voqealarga bog'liq bo'lgan va moliyaviy hisobotlarga ta'sir qilishi mumkin bo'lgan jiddiy noaniqlik mavjud bo'lsa, auditor hisobotga alohida e'tibor qaratiladigan masalalar (emphasis of matter) xatboshisini kiritishni ko'rib chiqishi lozim. 30-paragrafda bunday ta'kid auditorlik xulosasiga ta'sir qilmasligi qayd etilgan.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Islomiy moliya muassasasi jiddiy uzluksiz faoliyat (going concern) muammosiga duch kelgan va ushbu masala moliyaviy hisobotlarda tegishli tarzda yoritilgan (ochib berilgan). Auditor bu masalani hisobot foydalanuvchilari uchun nihoyatda muhim deb hisoblaydi. ASIFI 2 standartida qanday hisobot tartibi aniq ko'zda tutilgan?
uz.A: Auditor jiddiy uzluksiz faoliyat muammosini ta'kidlash uchun alohida e'tibor qaratiladigan masalalar (emphasis of matter) xatboshisini qo'shishi lozim.
uz.B: Auditor avtomatik ravishda salbiy xulosa berishi kerak, chunki muassasaning kelajakdagi faoliyati noaniq bo'lib qolmoqda.
uz.C: Auditor avtomatik ravishda xulosa berishdan bosh tortishi kerak, chunki muassasa o'z faoliyatini davom ettira olmasligi mumkin.
uz.D: Auditor qo'shimcha tushuntirishsiz qaydsiz (tozxulosa berishi lozim, chunki masala allaqachon hisobotda yoritilgan.
uz.True answer: Auditor jiddiy uzluksiz faoliyat muammosini ta'kidlash uchun alohida e'tibor qaratiladigan masalalar (emphasis of matter) xatboshisini qo'shishi lozim.
uz.main: 31-paragraf — Auditor uzluksiz faoliyat muammosiga doir muhim masalani yoritish uchun hisobotga alohida xatboshi qo'shish orqali auditorlik hisobotini modifikatsiya qilishi lozim. 34-paragrafda ko'plab jiddiy noaniqliklar mavjud bo'lgan o'ta og'ir holatlarda fikr bildirishdan bosh tortish ko'rib chiqilishi mumkinligi aytilgan.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Audit ko'lamining cheklanishi shunchalik muhim va keng qamrovli (yoppasiga ta'sir etuvchi) bo'lgan masalalarga daxldorki, auditor moliyaviy hisobotlar bo'yicha fikr shakllantira olmaydi va yetarli tegishli auditorlik dalillarini to'play olmaydi. Qanday hisobot natijasi maqbul hisoblanadi?
uz.A: Shartli-ijobiy xulosa berilishi kerak, chunki cheklov faqat auditorning yetarli dalillar to'plash imkoniyatiga ta'sir qiladi.
uz.B: Salbiy xulosa berilishi kerak, chunki dalillarning yo'qligi moliyaviy hisobotlarning chalg'ituvchi ekanligini ko'rsatadi.
uz.C: Fikr bildirishdan bosh tortish (disclaimer of opinion) berilishi kerak, chunki mazkur cheklov auditorga yetarli va tegishli audit dalillarini olishga to'sqinlik qiladi.
uz.D: Alohida e'tibor qaratiladigan masalalar xatboshisi bo'lgan qaydsiz xulosa berilishi kerak, chunki cheklovni foydalanuvchilarga tushuntirib berish mumkin.
uz.True answer: Fikr bildirishdan bosh tortish (disclaimer of opinion) berilishi kerak, chunki mazkur cheklov auditorga yetarli va tegishli audit dalillarini olishga to'sqinlik qiladi.
uz.main: 38-paragraf — Audit ko'lami (qamrovi) cheklanishining ehtimoliy ta'siri shunchalik muhim va keng qamrovli (pervasive) bo'lganda, auditor yetarli va tegishli audit dalillarini to'play olmaganligi sababli fikr bildirishdan bosh tortishi (disclaimer of opinion) lozim.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Auditor hisob siyosatining maqbulligi bo'yicha rahbariyat bilan kelisha olmadi. Buning moliyaviy hisobotlarga ta'siri muhim, ammo butun moliyaviy hisobotni chalg'ituvchi darajada keng qamrovli (yoppasigemas. Qaysi xulosa to'g'ri hisoblanadi?
uz.A: Qaydsiz xulosa berilishi kerak, chunki kelishmovchilik faqat rahbariyat tomonidan tanlangan hisob siyosatiga taalluqlidir.
uz.B: Ushbu shartlilik tegishli bo'lgan masalaning ta'sirlari 'istisno qilingan holda' (except for) deb ifodalangan shartli-ijobiy xulosa (qualified opinion) berilishi lozim.
uz.C: Salbiy xulosa berilishi kerak, chunki rahbariyat bilan yuzaga kelgan har qanday muhim kelishmovchilik auditorga qaydsiz xulosa berishga to'sqinlik qiladi.
uz.D: Fikr bildirishdan bosh tortish kerak, chunki auditor rahbariyatning hisob siyosati to'g'ri yoki noto'g'riligini aniqlay olmaydi.
uz.True answer: Ushbu shartlilik tegishli bo'lgan masalaning ta'sirlari 'istisno qilingan holda' (except for) deb ifodalangan shartli-ijobiy xulosa (qualified opinion) berilishi lozim.
uz.main: 37-paragraf — Qaydsiz xulosa berishning imkoni bo'lmagan, lekin kelishmovchilik ta'siri salbiy xulosa (adverse opinion) berish darajasida muhim va keng qamrovli bo'lmagan holatlarda shartli-ijobiy xulosa ('except for') ifodalanishi lozim.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Auditor muassasaning Shariat hay'ati tomonidan belgilangan Shariat qoidalari va tamoyillarining amalda tatbiq etilishi yuzasidan rahbariyat bilan kelisha olmadi. Ushbu masala moliyaviy hisobotlarga jiddiy ta'sir ko'rsatadi. Qaysi tasdiq Standartni eng to'g'ri aks ettiradi?
uz.A: Bunday kelishmovchilik auditorning hisobot mas'uliyatidan tashqarida, chunki Shariat masalalari faqat Shariat hay'ati tomonidan belgilanadi.
uz.B: Bunday kelishmovchilik qaydsiz xulosa berishga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin hamda uning ta'siriga qarab shartli-ijobiy yoki salbiy xulosaga olib kelishi mumkin.
uz.C: Bunday kelishmovchilik avtomatik tarzda xulosa berishdan bosh tortishni talab qiladi, chunki auditor Shariat hay'ati qaroriga e'tiroz bildira olmaydi.
uz.D: Bunday kelishmovchilik alohida e'tibor qaratiladigan masalalar xatboshisini talab qiladi, chunki Shariat masalalari moliyaviy hisobotlar bo'yicha auditor xulosasiga ta'sir qila olmaydi.
uz.True answer: Bunday kelishmovchilik qaydsiz xulosa berishga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin hamda uning ta'siriga qarab shartli-ijobiy yoki salbiy xulosaga olib kelishi mumkin.
uz.main: 36(b)-paragraf — Kelishmovchilik Shariat hay'ati tomonidan belgilangan Shariat qoidalari va tamoyillarining amalga oshirilishiga tegishli bo'lishi mumkin. Agar u jiddiy bo'lsa, oqibatiga qarab shartli-ijobiy yoki salbiy xulosaga sabab bo'ladi.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Rahbariyat ayrim buxgalteriya yozuvlariga kirishga ruxsat berishdan bosh tortdi. Auditor bu yozuvlarni zarur deb hisoblaydi, biroq oqilona muqobil audit amallari orqali yetarli va tegishli dalillarni to'plash imkoni mavjuAuditor o'z fikrini (xulosasini) o'zgartirishdan oldin nima qilishga harakat qilishi lozim?
uz.A: Zudlik bilan shartli-ijobiy xulosa chiqarish, chunki rahbariyat audit paytida buxgalteriya yozuvlariga kirishni cheklab qo'ydi.
uz.B: Zudlik bilan xulosa berishdan bosh tortish, chunki rahbariyat tomonidan qo'yilgan cheklovlar auditorga buxgalteriya yozuvlariga tayanishga xalal beradi.
uz.C: Rahbariyat cheklovini qabul qilish va mavjud dalillar uchungina auditor mas'ul ekanligini bildirib, qaydsiz xulosa chiqarish.
uz.D: Qaydsiz (tozxulosani asoslash uchun yetarli va tegishli audit dalillarini to'plash maqsadida oqilona muqobil tartib-taomillarni qo'llash.
uz.True answer: Qaydsiz (tozxulosani asoslash uchun yetarli va tegishli audit dalillarini to'plash maqsadida oqilona muqobil tartib-taomillarni qo'llash.
uz.main: 42-paragraf — Buxgalteriya yozuvlarining yetarli emasligi yoki zarur muolajani o'tkazish imkonsizligi kabi holatlarda audit ko'lami cheklanganda, auditor toza xulosani tasdiqlovchi dalillarni olish uchun oqilona muqobil audit amallarini o'tkazishga harakat qilishi kerak.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Taklif etilayotgan audit topshirig'i (kelishuvi) auditorga zarur deb hisoblangan tartib-taomilni bajarishga to'sqinlik qiluvchi shartnoma cheklovini o'z ichiga oladi. Auditor ushbu cheklov xulosa berishdan bosh tortishni talab qiladi deb hisoblaydi. ASIFI 2 bo'yicha auditorning odatiy munosabati qanday bo'lishi kerak?
uz.A: Topshiriqni qabul qilish va xulosa berishdan bosh tortish, chunki har qanday ko'lam cheklovi yakuniy hisobotdagi tegishli iboralar orqali hal qilinishi mumkin.
uz.B: Topshiriqni qabul qilish va shartli xulosa berish, chunki xulosa berishdan bosh tortish faqat audit to'liq yakunlangandan keyin qo'llanilishi kerak.
uz.C: Odatda bunday topshiriqni audit kelishuvi sifatida qabul qilmaslik, qonunchilikda majburiy qilib belgilanmagan bo'lsa va bu cheklov qonuniy burchlarni buzmasa.
uz.D: Topshiriqni qabul qilish va cheklangan muolajani audit rejasidan chiqarib tashlash, chunki rahbariyat topshiriq ko'lamini belgilash vakolatiga ega.
uz.True answer: Odatda bunday topshiriqni audit kelishuvi sifatida qabul qilmaslik, qonunchilikda majburiy qilib belgilanmagan bo'lsa va bu cheklov qonuniy burchlarni buzmasa.
uz.main: 41-paragraf — Agar taklif qilingan topshiriqda fikr bildirishdan bosh tortishga olib keluvchi cheklov mavjud bo'lsa, qonunchilik talab qilmagan taqdirda, auditor odatda bunday topshiriqni qabul qilmaydi.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Audit ko'lamining jiddiy cheklanganligi sababli auditor shartli-ijobiy xulosa (qualified opinion) berishi kerak. Auditor o'z hisobotiga qanday qo'shimcha ma'lumotlarni kiritishi lozim?
uz.A: Hisobot cheklovni tavsiflab berishi hamda cheklov bo'lmaganida talab qilinishi mumkin bo'lgan tuzatishlarni (tahrirlarni) ko'rsatishi lozim.
uz.B: Hisobot cheklovni tavsiflab berishi va moliyaviy hisobotlardagi har qanday noaniqlik uchun faqat rahbariyat javobgar ekanligini qayd etishi lozim.
uz.C: Hisobot ushbu cheklovni tushirib qoldirishi va buning o'rniga foydalanuvchilarga qo'shimcha ma'lumot olish uchun muassasaning ichki audit hisobotiga havola berishi lozim.
uz.D: Hisobot cheklovni tavsiflab berishi va moliyaviy hisobotlar to'g'ri va xolis tasavvur bermaydi deb avtomatik ravishda e'lon qilishi lozim.
uz.True answer: Hisobot cheklovni tavsiflab berishi hamda cheklov bo'lmaganida talab qilinishi mumkin bo'lgan tuzatishlarni (tahrirlarni) ko'rsatishi lozim.
uz.main: 43-paragraf — Audit ko'lami cheklanishi shartli-ijobiy yoki fikr bildirishdan bosh tortishni talab qilganda, hisobotda ushbu cheklov tavsiflanishi va agar cheklov bo'lmaganida zarur bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan tuzatishlar bayon qilinishi lozim.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Islomiy moliya muassasasi auditor tomonidan nomaqbul deb topilgan hisob siyosatini qo'llamoqdNatijada ta'sir muhim va yoppasiga (pervasive) bo'lib, auditor shartli fikr bildirish moliyaviy hisobotlarning chalg'ituvchi yoki to'liq emasligini yetarlicha aks ettirmaydi degan to'xtamga keladi. Qanday xulosa ifodalanishi kerak?
uz.A: Shartli-ijobiy xulosa berilishi kerak, chunki kelishmovchilik rahbariyat tomonidan qo'llanilgan hisob siyosatiga tegishlidir.
uz.B: Alohida e'tibor qaratiladigan masalalar xatboshisi kiritilishi kerak, chunki hisob siyosati allaqachon hisobot izohlarida keltirilgan.
uz.C: Salbiy xulosa (adverse opinion) berilishi kerak, chunki kelishmovchilik ta'siri shunchalik muhim va keng qamrovliki, shartli xulosa yetarli emas.
uz.D: Fikr bildirishdan bosh tortish kerak, chunki auditor rahbariyatning hisob siyosati tanlovi uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga ololmaydi.
uz.True answer: Salbiy xulosa (adverse opinion) berilishi kerak, chunki kelishmovchilik ta'siri shunchalik muhim va keng qamrovliki, shartli xulosa yetarli emas.
uz.main: 39-paragraf — Kelishmovchilik ta'siri shunchalik muhim va yoppasiga bo'lganda, shartli xulosa hisobotning chalg'ituvchi mohiyatini yetarlicha ochib berolmasa, salbiy xulosa (adverse opinion) bildirilishi shart.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI Audit standarti № 02: Auditorlik hisoboti (ASIFI 2)
uz.Question: Auditor moliyaviy hisobotlarga ta'sir qiluvchi muhim masala tufayli qaydsiz xulosadan boshqa fikr (modifikatsiyalangan xulosbildiradi. Auditorga nisbatan qaysi hisobot talabi qo'llaniladi?
uz.A: Auditor masalani qisqacha ko'rsatishi lozim, ammo odatda uning moliyaviy hisobotlarga mumkin bo'lgan moliyaviy ta'sirini tushuntirishi talab qilinmaydi.
uz.B: Auditor barcha asosiy sabablarning aniq tavsifini berishi va agar imkonsiz bo'lmasa, uning moliyaviy hisobotlarga mumkin bo'lgan ta'sirini miqdoriy jihatdan baholashi shart.
uz.C: Auditor faqat tegishli moliyaviy hisobot izohiga havola berishi kifoya, chunki foydalanuvchilar qolgan ma'lumotlarni rahbariyatdan olishlari mumkin.
uz.D: Auditor faqat salbiy xulosa chiqargandagina masalani batafsil bayon qilishi kerak, shartli-ijobiy xulosada esa faqat o'zgartirilgan fikr jumlasi kifoya qiladi.
uz.True answer: Auditor barcha asosiy sabablarning aniq tavsifini berishi va agar imkonsiz bo'lmasa, uning moliyaviy hisobotlarga mumkin bo'lgan ta'sirini miqdoriy jihatdan baholashi shart.
uz.main: 40-paragraf — Auditor qaydsiz xulosadan boshqa xulosa bildirgan har qanday holatda, hisobotda barcha tub sabablarning aniq tavsifi va imkon qadar moliyaviy hisobotlarga ehtimoliy ta'sirning miqdoriy ko'rsatkichi aks etishi shart.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 01: Shariat boshqaruvi tizimi (2024-yilgi tahrir)
uz.Question: Islomiy moliya muassasasining (IMM) ijroiya rahbariyati Shariat nazorati hay'ati (SNH) faoliyatini baholashni amalga oshiradi va natijalarni ko'rib chiqish uchun Direktorlar kengashiga taqdim etadi. Shariat boshqaruvi tizimiga ko'ra, ushbu holat qanday baholanishi lozim?
uz.A: Bu qoidabuzarlik hisoblanadi, chunki Shariat nazorati hay'atini baholash bevosita boshqaruv vakolati yuklatilgan shaxslar (TCWG)ning mas'uliyatidir.
uz.B: Agar Direktorlar kengashi ushbu baholashni ko'rib chiqsa va tasdiqlasa, bu qabul qilinishi mumkin.
uz.C: Agar Shariat nazorati hay'ati o'zining baholash jarayoniga oldindan rozilik bergan bo'lsa, bu maqbul hisoblanadi.
uz.D: Bu qoidabuzarlik hisoblanadi, chunki Shariat nazorati hay'ati har qanday shakldagi baholashga tortilmasligi lozim.
uz.True answer: Bu qoidabuzarlik hisoblanadi, chunki Shariat nazorati hay'atini baholash bevosita boshqaruv vakolati yuklatilgan shaxslar (TCWG)ning mas'uliyatidir.
uz.main: Asos: GS 1, 44-paragraf — Baholash TCWG tomonidan amalga oshirilishi kerak, ijrochi rahbariyat (senior management) tomonidan o'tkazilishi qat'iyan taqiqlanadi.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 01: Shariat boshqaruvi tizimi (2024-yilgi tahrir)
uz.Question: Jamoat manfaati subyekti (public interest entity) hisoblanmaydigan islomiy moliya muassasasi ichki Shariat auditi funksiyasini tashkil etgan, biroq tashqi Shariat auditorini tayinlamagan. Shariat boshqaruvi tizimiga ko'ra, bu holat qanday baholanadi?
uz.A: Bunga yo'l qo'yilmaydi, chunki tashqi Shariat auditi barcha islomiy moliya muassasalari uchun majburiydir.
uz.B: Bunga ruxsat etiladi, chunki tashqi Shariat auditi jamoat manfaati subyekti bo'lmagan muassasalar uchun tavsiya etiladi, ammo majburiy emas.
uz.C: Bunga yo'l qo'yilmaydi, chunki ichki Shariat auditi ishonchli kafolat bera olmaydi.
uz.D: Bunga faqat tartibga soluvchi organning maxsus roziligi bo'lgan taqdirdagina ruxsat beriladi.
uz.True answer: Bunga ruxsat etiladi, chunki tashqi Shariat auditi jamoat manfaati subyekti bo'lmagan muassasalar uchun tavsiya etiladi, ammo majburiy emas.
uz.main: Asos: GS 1, 56-paragraf — Tashqi Shariat auditi jamoat manfaati subyektlari (public interest entities) uchun 3 yildan so'ng majburiy bo'ladi, boshqa tashkilotlar uchun esa tavsiya etiladi.

uz.Theme: AAOIFI GS 01: Shariat boshqaruvi tizimi (2024-yilgi tahrir)
uz.Question: Islomiy moliya muassasasi o'z Shariat nazorati hay'ati chiqargan qaror bilan tegishli nazorat organi chiqargan Shariat ko'rsatmalari o'rtasida farqqa (tafovutgduch keldi. Hech qanday maxsus AAOIFI Shariat standarti bu masalani qamrab olmagan. Shariat qoidalari iyerarxiyasiga ko'ra, bu masala qanday hal qilinishi lozim?
uz.A: Muassasa nazorat organining Shariat ko'rsatmalariga rioya qilishi lozim.
uz.B: Muassasa o'z Shariat nazorati hay'atining qaroriga amal qilishi lozim.
uz.C: Muassasa tijorat manfaatlaridan kelib chiqqan holda ikkala pozitsiyadan birini qabul qilishi mumkin.
